name: open-money-agent
description: See what your Open Money Agent wallet on Polygon holds, and open its dashboard.

interface.longDescription:
Open Money Agent is your own agent wallet on Polygon, on the Open Money Stack. Connect it to ChatGPT to ask what the wallet holds and get a link to its dashboard.

Sign in with the email or Google account you use for Open Money Agent. ChatGPT then sees that one wallet: its address, each token it holds valued in US dollars, the total, and your dashboard link. If you don't have a wallet yet, signing in creates one.

Who it's for: people who already use Open Money Agent with an assistant, or who want to check their agent wallet without opening the dashboard.

Limitations: this connection only reads. It can't send, swap, or move funds, and it only shows the wallet you signed in with, on Polygon. Disconnect it any time from Settings on your dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Give me my Open Money Agent dashboard link

positive.expected_behavior: The total the wallet holds in US dollars and each token with its dollar value. A new wallet that hasn't been funded reports $0 and no tokens.
The connected wallet's 0x address on Polygon.

positive.prompt: Give me my Open Money Agent dashboard link
positive.expected_behavior: A link to agents.polygon.technology that opens the dashboard for the connected wallet.

positive.prompt: How much USDC does my agent wallet have?
positive.expected_behavior: The wallet's USDC in US dollars, or that it holds no USDC (as for a new, unfunded wallet).

positive.prompt: Which account is my agent wallet connected with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email the wallet is signed in with and the wallet's address.

negative.description: Sending funds is not supported: the plugin only reads the wallet
negative.prompt: Send 5 USDC from my agent wallet to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD

negative.description: Swapping tokens is not supported: the plugin only reads the wallet
Wallets other than the connected one are not available

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads the connected wallet.

publication.release_notes: See what your Open Money Agent wallet on Polygon holds, its address, and your dashboard link. Read-only.
